Subtract 49 weeks and 6 days = 49*7 + 6 = 343 + 6 = 349 days.  
1795 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100, not by 400).  
Counting back: June 5, 1795 minus 349 days.  
May has 31 days, April 30, March 31, February 28, January 31, December 31, November 30, October 31, September 30, August 31, July 31.  

From June 5 back 5 days → May 31.  
Remaining days: 349 - 5 = 344.  
Back through May (31 days) → May 31 to May 1 is 30 days back, so 344 - 30 = 314 left, date at May 1.  
Continue backward month by month:  
April (30) → 314 - 30 = 284, date at April 1.  
March (31) → 284 - 31 = 253, date at March 1.  
February (28) → 253 - 28 = 225, date at February 1.  
January (31) → 225 - 31 = 194, date at January 1, 1795.  

Now back into 1794 (not leap year).  
December 31, 1794 → 194 - 31 = 163, date at December 1, 1794.  
November 30 → 163 - 30 = 133, date at November 1.  
October 31 → 133 - 31 = 102, date at October 1.  
September 30 → 102 - 30 = 72, date at September 1.  
August 31 → 72 - 31 = 41, date at August 1.  
July 31 → 41 - 31 = 10, date at July 1.  
June 30 → need 10 days back from July 1: July 1 back 1 day = June 30, back 10 days total = June 21.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1794-06-21
